title: Port Louis opposition march demanding the government’s departure
location: Port Louis, Mauritius; reported route through central streets to Place d’Armes, past the Prime Minister’s office and Parliament
scope: Capital-city march; no national multi-location organization is established in the read scope.
organizer: Main opposition parties (not individually named in the opened report)
participants_original: “Several thousand Mauritians,” as reported by PANA.
threshold_50_evidence: PANA reports several thousand participants, a qualitative estimate clearly above the 50-person threshold; no numeric count or bounds are assigned.

start_date.summary: The opened article identifies the march as taking place on 13 February 2021.

end_date.summary: The article does not identify the march’s physical ending or a last date of protest activity; end date remains unknown.

location.summary: The opened report places the march in Port Louis and describes its route to Place d’Armes via central streets.

scope.summary: The opened report describes a march through Port Louis; no multiple-location national organization is established.

organizer.summary: The report attributes the march to the main opposition parties without naming them individually.

demands.summary: The report says marchers demanded the departure of the government led by Pravind Jugnauth. The May 2015 codebook’s removal category is tied to a corrupt or reviled political person; the read scope does not state that motive, so this is coded as a political-process demand.

participants_original.summary: The report’s qualitative wording is “several thousand Mauritians.”

threshold_50_evidence.summary: “Several thousand” is a qualitative crowd estimate plainly above 50; it does not support a specific lower/upper bound.

protester_violence.summary: The report expressly characterizes the march as peaceful.

accommodation.summary: The opened article does not report this response dimension; silence is not coded as an explicit absence.

notes: One opened PANA English page is the factual basis. It is the same-agency story family as the Portuguese PANA source MAU2021S050 and duplicate English URL card MAU2021S022 in the January dossier. The route destination and speeches do not establish the physical end of the gathering. No official MM event ID is assigned.
open_questions: Independent contemporaneous corroboration of occurrence, attendance, and demand.
Exact crowd number; PANA provides only “several thousand.”
Physical start time, end time/date, and whether any activity continued after 13 February.
Police and other state response across all seven dimensions.
Names and full organizational roles of the opposition parties; no broad national coordination inferred from this report.
